page_explainer: Register the access-proxy your team has installed in your own network so postman-cli can route vault-substituted requests through it. Your secrets never traverse Postman cloud.
empty_state: Register your team's access proxy here so the Postman CLI can route vault-substituted requests through it. Your secrets stay in your network.
field_description_placeholder: Optional — what this proxy is for
ca_explainer: The access-proxy needs an RSA private key + CA cert that it presents on the TLS handshake. Generate one here (we never see the private key) or paste your own.
ca_generate_hint: RSA-2048 key + self-signed cert, valid 5 years. Runs in your browser via WebCrypto — the private key never reaches Postman cloud.
ca_generated_warning: Copy both PEM blocks. They are held only in your browser tab and disappear when you close this modal — Postman cloud never sees them.
field_proxy_url_hint: The HTTPS URL where you ran the access-proxy. postman-cli uses this to fetch /ca.pem and /issue-cert.
reveal_warning: Copy the values below now. They will not be shown again.
reveal_subtext: These values go into your access-proxy deployment's environment. We recommend reading them from your vault and injecting at container start — don't hardcode them in the docker run command below.
docker_run_hint: Substitute the env values above. Replace YOUR_VAULT_ADDR/YOUR_VAULT_TOKEN with your secret store endpoint.
confirm_delete: Delete access proxy "{name}"? Existing CLI clients will keep working until they re-run setup.
confirm_rotate: Rotate the bundle secret? Existing CLI clients will stop working until they paste the new secret into their access-proxy env. Continue?
rotated_subtext: Update your access-proxy's POSTMAN_PPROXY_BUNDLE_SECRET env var to this new value, then restart the proxy. Existing CLI sessions will stop working until you do.
public_key_explainer: Paste the access-proxy's RSA public key. ACS encrypts vault references with it so only your proxy (which holds the matching private key) can decrypt them — Postman never sees the private key.
